matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the inconsistency between the gap condition in Theorem 2.1 (4‖E‖ ≤ δ_p) and Lemma 3.1 (δ_p > 5‖E‖). Pred_id 2 directly identifies this inconsistency, noting that Lemma 3.1 states δ_p > 5‖E‖ while Theorem 2.1 assumes 4‖E‖ < δ_p, and that the proof uses 4‖E‖. This is the same defect despite the verifier not having the exact original text.

GT2 concerns ambiguous notation in Theorem 2.3 regarding whether the maximum is over the boundary (∂Γ₁) or interior (Γ₁) of the rectangle. Pred_id 4 identifies this exact issue, noting that the theorem uses ∂Γ₁ (boundary) but earlier Γ₁ was defined differently, creating ambiguous notation. This detects the same notational inconsistency problem.
